preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url WHERE url_path = '/SampleEdit' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Grant /ModifyOrder the same module-url mappings as /SampleEdit to align access checks
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id, system_module_param_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), '/ModifyOrder', smu.system_module_id, smu.system_module_param_id FROM clinlims.system_module_url smu WHERE smu.url_path = '/SampleEdit' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url existing WHERE existing.url_path = '/ModifyOrder' AND existing.system_module_id = smu.system_module_id AND COALESCE(existing.system_module_param_id, -1) = COALESCE(smu.system_module_param_id, -1) );
